narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the repository structure.
finalText:
**Wrote 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Of 380 commits, 15 matter to users.

Four are breaking. An expired token now returns `401`, not `403`. Internal error types are no longer re-exported. The `v1` export route is gone. Latency histogram units were fixed, so dashboards shift. Those last three were filed as `refactor` and `fix`, so they were easy to miss.

One feature. Webhook deliveries now retry with backoff. The rest is 8 fixes. All 153 dependency bumps are patch or minor.

Next: I left out 10 `perf` commits. The template allows only three headings. Say the word and I add a Performance section.
